course.title: Unit 5 What a Delicious Meal!【例句】

sentences.content: Cooking is love made visible.
sentences.english: Cooking is love made visible
sentences.chinese: 烹饪是爱的有形表达。

sentences.content: That is what my grandmother always told me.
sentences.english: That is what my grandmother always told me
sentences.chinese: 这是我祖母经常对我说的话。

sentences.content: Thanks to her, I love cooking.
sentences.english: Thanks to her , I love cooking
sentences.chinese: 多亏了她，我爱上了烹饪。

sentences.content: It’s a great way for me to share my love with others.
sentences.english: It's a great way for me to share my love with others
sentences.chinese: 这是我将爱传递给他人的绝佳方式。

sentences.content: Every time I sit at the table, after cooking for my family, we create memories.
sentences.english: Every time I sit at the table , after cooking for my family , we create memories
sentences.chinese: 每当我为家人下厨后围坐餐桌时，我们都在创造美好回忆。

sentences.content: The smells and the food’s taste, along with our conversations, connect us to each other.
sentences.english: The smells and the food's taste , along with our conversations , connect us to each other
sentences.chinese: 食物的香气与滋味，连同我们的交谈，将彼此紧密相连。

sentences.content: What wonderful memories I have!
sentences.english: What wonderful memories I have !
sentences.chinese: 多么美好的回忆啊！

sentences.content: One of my favourite memories is my grandmother’s pumpkin pie.
sentences.english: One of my favourite memories is my grandmother's pumpkin pie
sentences.chinese: 我最珍贵的回忆之一就是祖母做的南瓜派。

sentences.content: She always made it in autumn, when the weather got colder.
sentences.english: She always made it in autumn , when the weather got colder
sentences.chinese: 她总是在天气转凉的秋天制作它。

sentences.content: Her friendly kitchen was the perfect place to warm up and enjoy a taste of the changing seasons.
sentences.english: Her friendly kitchen was the perfect place to warm up and enjoy a taste of the changing seasons
sentences.chinese: 她温馨的厨房是取暖和品尝季节更迭滋味的绝佳去处。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时

sentences.content: I still remember the days when the smell of cinnamon filled the room with sweetness.
sentences.english: I still remember the days when the smell of cinnamon filled the room with sweetness
sentences.chinese: 我依然记得那些日子里，肉桂的香气让整个房间都弥漫着甜蜜。

sentences.content: Now, every time I smell cinnamon, I think of my grandmother’s pumpkin pie.
sentences.english: Now , every time I smell cinnamon , I think of my grandmother's pumpkin pie
sentences.chinese: 如今，每当我闻到肉桂的香味，就会想起祖母做的南瓜派。

sentences.content: My grandmother told me about her first pumpkin pie.
sentences.english: My grandmother told me about her first pumpkin pie
sentences.chinese: 我的祖母向我讲述了她第一次做南瓜派的故事。

sentences.content: When she was a college student in the US, she stayed with a host family.
sentences.english: When she was a college student in the US , she stayed with a host family
sentences.chinese: 当她在美国读大学时，曾寄宿在一个寄宿家庭。

sentences.content: One year around Thanksgiving, the hostess taught her how to make a pumpkin pie.
sentences.english: One year around Thanksgiving , the hostess taught her how to make a pumpkin pie
sentences.chinese: 有一年临近感恩节，女主人教她如何制作南瓜派。

sentences.content: Many years later, she taught me how to make it too.
sentences.english: Many years later , she taught me how to make it too
sentences.chinese: 多年以后，她也教会了我如何制作。

sentences.content: My grandmother loved learning how to make food from other cultures.
sentences.english: My grandmother loved learning how to make food from other cultures
sentences.chinese: 我的祖母喜欢学习如何制作其他文化的美食。

sentences.content: It’s my way of making friends from around the world.
sentences.english: It's my way of making friends from around the world
sentences.chinese: 这是我结交世界各地朋友的方式。

sentences.content: Grandmother taught me the secret to cooking: Cook with love.
sentences.english: Grandmother taught me the secret to cooking : Cook with love
sentences.chinese: 祖母教会了我烹饪的秘诀：用爱烹饪。

sentences.content: Thanks to my grandmother, I love to try new food and new recipes from other countries and cultures.
sentences.english: Thanks to my grandmother , I love to try new food and new recipes from other countries and cultures
sentences.chinese: 多亏了我的祖母，我喜欢尝试来自其他国家和文化的新食物和新食谱。
